steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Additive manufacturing builds components layer by layer from a digital model, adding material rather than removing it. | Key Fact: Fused Deposition Modelling (FDM) extrudes thermoplastic filament through a heated nozzle; the most common and affordable 3D printing method. | Key Fact: Selective Laser Sintering (SLS) uses a laser to fuse powdered material (nylon, metal) layer by layer; produces strong, functional parts. | Key Fact: Stereolithography (SLA) uses a UV laser to cure liquid resin; produces very high-resolution parts with smooth surface finish.
